components.name: Button
components.summary: Triggers an action. Pill-shaped, 40px tall (32px with `size="sm"`).

components.name: ActionButton
components.summary: A button that shows its own result. Click "Book" and it changes to "Booked" in place, with no toast or page change.

components.name: ProgressButton
components.summary: A button for slower work, like a submission or an upload. A darker fill sweeps across it as the work runs, with the percentage in the label. It ends on a success or an error.

components.name: HoldButton
components.summary: A destructive action that needs a press and hold instead of a confirmation dialog. A `danger` outline draws itself around the pill while it's held. Let go early and nothing happens. Hold for the full time and the trash lid pops, the label changes to "Deleted", and the button fades.

components.name: UndoButton
components.summary: Deletes at once, then gives people a few seconds to change their mind. The button turns into "Deleted · Undo", with a line shrinking along the bottom. If the line runs out, the delete is final.

components.name: ReactionButton
components.summary: A toggle for small, personal reactions: star, like or save. Turning it on pops the icon and bursts a ring of dots. Turning it off is quiet.

components.name: Input
components.summary: A single-line text field with a visible label, an optional hint and an optional error message.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: A single on/off choice with a visible label. It's a native checkbox underneath, styled with an `ink` fill when checked.
components.props: export interface CheckboxProps extends React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement> { label: React.ReactNode; hint?: React.ReactNode; indeterminate?: boolean; }

components.name: RadioGroup
components.summary: One choice from a short list, in a fieldset with a legend. The chosen option shows an `ink` ring and dot. Arrow keys move between options, as with native radios.
components.props: export interface RadioGroupProps { legend: React.ReactNode; options: { value: string; label: React.ReactNode; hint?: React.ReactNode; disabled?: boolean }[]; value?: string; defaultValue?: string; onChange?: (value: string) => void; name?: string; hint?: React.ReactNode; inline?: boolean; className?: string; }

components.name: Switch
components.summary: An on/off setting that applies straight away. When it's on, the track fills `ink` and the `surface-200` knob slides across with a check. This matches how Checkbox and Radio show "on", and keeps `wattle` for actions. It uses `role="switch"` and `aria-checked`.
components.props: export interface SwitchProps { label: React.ReactNode; hint?: React.ReactNode; checked?: boolean; defaultChecked?: boolean; onChange?: (on: boolean) => void; disabled?: boolean; id?: string; className?: string; }

components.name: Select
components.summary: A native dropdown, styled to match Input: a `border-strong` outline, a chevron, and the same label, hint and error. Because it's native, keyboards, screen readers and phone pickers all work as expected.
components.props: export interface SelectProps extends React.SelectHTMLAttributes<HTMLSelectElement> { label?: React.ReactNode; hint?: React.ReactNode; error?: React.ReactNode; options: (string | { value: string; label: React.ReactNode })[]; placeholder?: string; }

components.name: Textarea
components.summary: Multi-line text, styled like Input. It starts 96px tall, and people can drag it taller.
components.props: export interface TextareaProps extends React.TextareaHTMLAttributes<HTMLTextAreaElement> { label?: React.ReactNode; hint?: React.ReactNode; error?: React.ReactNode; }

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Switches between views of the same thing, like a course's lessons, tests and notes. The active tab is `ink` with a 2px `ink` underline that grows in. The others are `ink-muted`.
components.props: export interface TabsProps { tabs: { id: string; label: React.ReactNode; content: React.ReactNode; icon?: IconName | React.ReactNode; count?: number }[]; label?: string; defaultTab?: string; onChange?: (id: string) => void; className?: string; }

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: A modal that asks one question or holds one short task. It's built on the native `<dialog>`, so focus stays inside, Esc closes it, and the page behind becomes inert. It uses `surface-200`, a hairline, `radius-md` and `shadow-dialog` over a dimmed backdrop.
components.props: export interface DialogProps { open: boolean; onClose?: () => void; title: React.ReactNode; children?: React.ReactNode; footer?: React.ReactNode; dismissable?: boolean; className?: string; }

components.name: Toaster
components.summary: Short messages that confirm something happened elsewhere on the page. They rise in at the bottom centre on an `ink` pill (cream in the dark theme) with `shadow-overlay`, then leave on their own.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: A short `ink` label that appears on hover or keyboard focus, after 250ms. It names what an icon-only control does. Esc hides it.
components.props: export interface TooltipProps { label: React.ReactNode; children: React.ReactElement; side?: 'top' | 'bottom'; delay?: number; }

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.summary: A button that opens a short list of actions, such as an item's "…" overflow menu or "Sort by". The menu sits on `surface-200` with a hairline and `shadow-overlay`.
components.props: export interface DropdownMenuProps { items: DropdownMenuItem[]; label?: React.ReactNode; ariaLabel?: string; icon?: IconName | React.ReactNode; variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'ghost'; size?: 'md' | 'sm'; align?: 'start' | 'end'; }

components.name: Card
components.summary: A raised `surface-200` panel with a `hairline` border and `radius-md` corners. Each card holds one thing: an event, a booking, a person, a result.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: A small pill label for status or category, like "New", "Beginner" or "Batch A". It is not clickable.

components.name: CountBadge
components.summary: A small `ink` pill with a number, like unread messages or new submissions. The number rolls when it changes, and anything over `max` shows as "99+".
components.props: export interface CountBadgeProps { count: number; max?: number; label?: string; showZero?: boolean; className?: string; }

components.name: Status
components.summary: A coloured dot and a word that say what state something is in. It's lighter than a Badge, so use it in lists and tables.
components.props: export interface StatusProps { tone?: 'neutral' | 'live' | 'active' | 'done' | 'danger'; children: React.ReactNode; className?: string; }

components.name: Tag
components.summary: A chip for things people choose and can take away again, like subjects, batches and filters.
components.props: export interface TagProps { children: React.ReactNode; onRemove?: () => void; selected?: boolean; onClick?: () => void; label?: string; className?: string; }

components.name: IconDisc
components.summary: A single icon in a round disc. It anchors an announcement, an empty state or a shortcut card.
components.props: export interface IconDiscProps { icon: IconName | React.ReactNode; tone?: 'neutral' | 'strong' | 'danger'; size?: number; label?: string; className?: string; }

components.name: DateBlock
components.summary: A calendar-page date: the month in small caps above the day in large Fraunces. Put it beside an event's title.
components.props: export interface DateBlockProps { date?: string | number | Date; month?: string; day?: number | string; label?: string; className?: string; }

components.name: MetaList
components.summary: Rows of small details (dates, times, places, people), each with a 16px icon, in `ink-muted`.
components.props: export interface MetaListProps { items: { icon?: IconName | React.ReactNode; text: React.ReactNode }[]; className?: string; }

components.name: Progress
components.summary: A thin `earth` bar that shows how far along something is. It animates when the value changes.
components.props: export interface ProgressProps { value: number; max?: number; label: string; showValue?: boolean; className?: string; }

components.name: Checklist
components.summary: A short list of tick boxes. They're real checkboxes under the styling, so keyboards and screen readers work as usual. Done items are struck through in `ink-muted`.
components.props: export interface ChecklistProps { items: { label: React.ReactNode; done?: boolean }[]; done?: boolean[]; onChange?: (done: boolean[]) => void; label?: string; className?: string; }

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: A round initials badge for a person: `ink` on `taupe` (6:1), in Fraunces.
components.props: export interface AvatarProps { name: string; initials?: string; size?: number; className?: string; }

components.name: Stat
components.summary: One big number in Fraunces, with an optional unit and a one-line trend. The number rolls in when it changes.
components.props: export interface StatProps { value: React.ReactNode; unit?: React.ReactNode; label?: React.ReactNode; trend?: React.ReactNode; trendDirection?: 'up' | 'down' | 'flat'; className?: string; }

components.name: Sparkline
components.summary: A small `earth` line chart with an `ink` dot on the latest value. It shows the shape, not exact values.
components.props: export interface SparklineProps { data: number[]; height?: number; label?: string; className?: string; }

components.name: SeatMap
components.summary: A grid of dots that shows how many places are taken and how many are left. Taken places are filled `earth`, free ones are `border-strong` rings, and the person's own place pops in `wattle` with an `ink` ring.
components.props: export interface SeatMapProps { total: number; taken: number; columns?: number; mine?: boolean; label?: string; className?: string; }

components.name: Icon
components.summary: Draws one of the 31 starter icons inline as SVG. Icons come from Lucide v0.460.0 (ISC licence) and are drawn with a 1.5px stroke in `currentColor`.

components.name: toast
components.summary: Wattle.toast(message, { tone, actionLabel, onAction, duration }) shows a toast; render <Toaster /> once.
components.props: export interface ToastOptions { tone?: 'neutral' | 'success' | 'danger'; actionLabel?: string; onAction?: () => void; duration?: number; }
